title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with our city guide. Compare prices from $15-$40/week
intro: Aucklanders have plenty of gym options to choose from, with prices ranging from $15 to over $40 per week. With so many choices, it can be hard to decide which gym is best for you. In this guide, we'll break down the best gyms in Auckland by suburb and compare their prices.

sections.heading: Gyms in the Auckland CBD
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, with options like Anytime Fitness, Snap Fitness, and Les Mills. These gyms are perfect for commuters who want to fit in a workout before or after work.

sections.heading: Gyms by Suburb
list: North Shore: Snap Fitness, Anytime Fitness
Auckland CBD: Les Mills, Jetts, City Fitness

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms
sections.body: If you're looking for a gym that's convenient for your commute, consider a gym with 24/7 access like Anytime Fitness or Snap Fitness. These gyms have multiple locations throughout Auckland and offer flexible membership options.

sections.heading: Parking and Accessibility
sections.body: Some gyms in Auckland offer free parking, while others are located near public transport hubs. Be sure to check the gym's website or call ahead to confirm their parking and accessibility options.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: With so many gym options in Auckland, it's easy to find one that fits your budget and meets your needs. Be sure to compare prices, contract terms, and amenities before making a decision. Happy exercising!
